card.description:
**Hollister-Whitney (O) – Quincy, IL 62305**

**Overview**
------------

**Level:** Experienced 
**Category:** Salaried

**Description**
---------------

If you are a hands-on manufacturing leader who thrives on the production floor, develops high-performing teams, and drives measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity, we want to talk to you. We are seeking an experienced Plant Manager to lead a designated manufacturing value stream at Hollister-Whitney, part of Vantage Elevation.

**About Us**
------------

Vantage Elevation, LLC is North America’s leading independent manufacturer of elevator components and systems. Vantage is comprised of eight business units, including GAL Manufacturing, GAL Canada, Hollister-Whitney, Elevator Controls, Courion, Bore-Max, Thames Valley Controls, and Vertical Dimensions.

Through its brands, Vantage supplies nearly all electromechanical devices used in contemporary elevators. Founded in 1927, Vantage employs more than 900 people across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

As the Plant Manager, you will lead all aspects of an assigned manufacturing value stream and serve as a key member of the Hollister-Whitney leadership team. You will be accountable for driving performance in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, and employee engagement while developing a high-performing team of supervisors, team leads, and production employees.

This is a highly visible, hands-on leadership role that requires a strong and consistent presence on the manufacturing floor. You will work closely with Engineering, Quality, Materials, Supply Chain, Maintenance, Environmental Health and Safety, Human Resources, and Customer Service to achieve production and business objectives.

The successful candidate will be an accountable, people-focused leader who uses data, Lean principles, and disciplined execution to deliver sustainable results. This role is ideal for an ambitious manufacturing professional who is motivated to grow into broader plant leadership responsibilities over time.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

A typical day may include:

* Lead the daily production activities of an assigned manufacturing value stream, ensuring production plans are executed safely, efficiently, and in alignment with customer commitments
* Drive performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and employee engagement using operational metrics and disciplined corrective action
* Maintain a visible presence on the manufacturing floor, remove production barriers, and optimize labor, equipment, materials, and other resources
* Lead, coach, and develop Production Supervisors, Team Leads, and hourly employees while establishing clear expectations and accountability for results
* Build a culture of safety, quality, collaboration, respect, and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with OSHA requirements and company policies
* Lead safety observations, incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to reduce workplace hazards, defects, scrap, and rework
* Champion Lean Manufacturing practices, including Kaizen events, waste reduction, and initiatives to improve throughput, OEE, labor utilization, inventory accuracy, and first-pass yield
* Manage labor efficiency, overtime, productivity, manufacturing costs, departmental budgets, and improvement opportunities that support profitability
* Partner with Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Materials, Maintenance, EHS, Human Resources, and Customer Service to resolve challenges and achieve business objectives
* Lead organizational change with urgency, sound judgment, and a strong focus on employees and customers

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and manufacturing leadership experience
* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience
* At least five years of experience leading supervisors and hourly production teams
* Demonstrated success leading production in a heavy industrial manufacturing environment, such as metal fabrication, machining, welding, capital equipment, industrial equipment, or engineered products manufacturing
* Proven ability to improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and overall production performance
* Experience implementing Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives
* Strong business acumen with the ability to manage operational metrics, budgets, and financial performance
* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop employees and frontline leaders
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Sound judgment, emotional intelligence, and the ability to lead effectively through change
* Proven ability to influence others and drive accountability across functional boundaries
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and ERP systems

### **Preferred**

* MBA or advanced technical degree
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Experience with ERP systems such as Infor, SAP, Oracle, or a comparable platform
* Experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system
* Experience in a union manufacturing environment
* Multi-site manufacturing leadership experience

**Benefits of Working With Us**
-------------------------------

* Competitive base salary of $110,000-$140,000 (commensurate with experience, qualifications, and market conditions)
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* 401(k) with Company Match and Non-Elective Contribution
* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Annual Incentive Compensation Program (ICP)
* Career Development and Growth Opportunities
* ...and more

**Position Details**
--------------------

* Full-Time
* First Shift
* Location: Quincy, IL—on-site at Hollister-Whitney
* Member of the Site Leadership Team
* Direct supervision of Production Supervisors, Team Leads, and production employees
* Reports to the Vice President and General Manager

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Vantage Elevation, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind in accordance with applicable laws.

card.description:
**Seating Plant Manager**

**Position Summary**
====================

DARRAN is a family-owned furniture manufacturer based in High Point, North Carolina, creating thoughtfully designed furniture for 50 years. Our work brings together craftsmanship, innovation, and a commitment to quality, supported by people who take pride in what they build.
===================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

We are seeking a Production Manager over our Seating Operations to guide our seating manufacturing operation and support its continued growth. This leadership role brings together people, processes, and craftsmanship to build a strong team and deliver exceptional products. The ideal candidate leads by example, develops others, and creates an environment where accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.


**Management and People Leadership**
====================================

* Direct and supervise seating department employees, assign work, communicate daily priorities, and hold employees accountable for meeting expectations.
* Set clear expectations for productivity, quality, attendance, conduct, and safe work practices. Ensure employees understand their responsibilities and department goals.
* Monitor individual and team performance daily, including output, work quality, efficiency, attendance, and adherence to established procedures. Identify concerns and address them promptly.
* Provide ongoing coaching and timely feedback. Establish improvement expectations, document follow-up, and verify that required improvements are achieved and sustained.
* Administer and document disciplinary actions in partnership with HR and in accordance with company policy. Clearly communicate the concern, required correction, and consequences of continued issues.
* Complete annual performance reviews and provide accurate, specific feedback supported by documented performance observations.
* Partner with HR on hiring and employee matters. Coordinate onboarding and training, assess employee skills, and identify development and cross-training needs.
* Apply company policies consistently, address employee concerns respectfully, and maintain clear communication with employees, HR, and senior operations leadership.

**Production**
==============

* Lead daily production startup and ensure teams, materials, and priorities are ready at the beginning of each shift.
* Manage production flow across frame building, cutting, sewing, upholstering, and final assembly to keep work on schedule.
* Partner with senior operations leadership to review daily objectives, constraints, and priorities.
* Drive results across output, delivery performance, labor utilization, overtime, quality, and production flow.
* Develop and improve standard operating procedures and processes that increase throughput and reduce bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with outside and original-equipment suppliers to maintain production capacity and quality standards while expanding internal capabilities.
* Collaborate with engineering and product development on patterns, production readiness, and the launch of new seating collections.
* Establish, maintain, and enforce quality checks and corrective actions.
* Coordinate maintenance needs, execute safety programs, and reinforce safe work practices throughout the operation.
* Advance shop-floor organization and housekeeping practices that support a structured, clean, and efficient workplace.

**How Success Is Measured**
===========================

Success is measured by consistent people leadership and department results against goals established with senior operations leadership. Performance is evaluated through production and quality reports, employee performance records, training progress, and completion of corrective actions.

* People management and accountability: Employees understand their goals and responsibilities. Performance and attendance concerns are addressed promptly, company policies are applied consistently, and coaching and disciplinary actions are documented with HR.
* Performance improvement: Individual and team results are monitored regularly. Employees receive specific feedback, improvement expectations and follow-up dates are documented, and progress is verified. Annual reviews are completed on time.
* Employee development: New employees complete assigned training, demonstrated skills meet job requirements, and cross-training improves coverage across seating operations.
* Production and delivery: Actual output and on-time completion meet established targets. Bottlenecks and schedule delays are identified early, communicated, and addressed.
* Quality: Products meet established standards. Defects, rework, and recurring quality issues are tracked, and corrective actions produce sustained improvement.
* Labor and operational efficiency: Labor utilization and overtime remain within established expectations. Process improvements reduce avoidable downtime and improve production flow.
* Safety and workplace organization: Safe work practices and housekeeping standards are consistently enforced. Hazards and incidents are reported promptly, and assigned corrective actions are completed by their due dates.
* Communication and follow-through: Priorities, staffing concerns, and production risks are communicated promptly to the appropriate partners. Assigned actions and production readiness milestones are completed on time.

**Qualifications**
==================

* 10+ years of upholstery, pattern, and assembly experience and 5+ years of running an upholstery operation.
* High school diploma or GED required.
* Strong reading, writing, math, analysis, comprehension, administrative, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to set clear priorities, manage and hold people accountable, monitor performance, document personnel matters, and collaborate across operations, HR, engineering, product development, and suppliers.
* A practical, continuous-improvement mindset with a strong commitment to safety, quality, delivery, and respectful people leadership.

**Physical Requirements and Work Environment**
==============================================

This is an on-site role in an active manufacturing environment. The position requires excellent vision, hearing/listening, and clear speech; hand and finger dexterity; lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds; pushing and pulling; local driving; color perception; touch/feel; and the ability to move within and between facilities. Work includes frequent face-to-face and verbal interaction with others and may involve dirt or dust, fumes or odors, moving objects, and work at heights.

**Benefits**
============

401(k), dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, paid time off, retirement plan, and vision insurance.

card.description:
**About The Role:**

As a CBRE VAS Quality & Risk Management (QRM) Senior Director, identifies, manages and mitigates risk through an established global framework leveraging our perspectives, scale and connections to provide industry-leading valuation and advisory services. Institutional Funds Valuations (IVAS) is a fast growing department of CBRE VAS Dedicated to servicing the appraisal requirements of large institutional fund clients. The purpose of this position is to implement the CBRE Quality and Risk Management (QRM) function within IVAS.

This will include the enforcement, oversight and delivery of the QRM Framework as applicable to IVAS.

You will engage with clients and will be an integral part of both the IVAS department and the QRM team, with a passion for innovation and the desire to build something unique.

**What You'll Do:**

* The QRM Director (IVAS) is an experienced appraisal professional who serves as the subject matter expert for the implementation and delivery of the QRM Framework across IVAS.
* The role is key to ensuring processes, procedures and the delivery of services are in line with regulatory, client and internal guidelines while also providing ongoing support for appraisers and IVAS management to manage risk.
* The QRM Director (IVAS) will predominantly provide approval of incoming Risk Assessments (RA) and participate in the appraisal review process, ensuring all appraisals are of high quality, comply with internal guidelines, uphold appraiser independence and are in line with regulatory and client standards, including USPAP requirements.
* The QRM Director (IVAS) will collaborate closely with all key stakeholders to drive Quality and Risk Management initiatives within the Division and align these initiatives with both the United States and Global QRM Business Plan.
* Responsibilities include ensuring compliance, as applicable, with the Global and United States QRM Framework through the following activities:
* Ensuring IVAS compliance with the CBRE VAS Appraisal Report Review Process, including personally completing reviews within the IVAS line of business within agreed turnaround time requirements.
* Ensuring IVAS adherence to VAS Practice Area Guidelines (PAG) and key risk mitigation procedures.
* Following Risk Assessment procedures.
* Following escalation procedures.
* Implementing systems to track client contracting status.
* Following and implementing audit procedures.
* In conjunction with Senior QRM Management, driving and delivering initiatives to embed Core-QRM Operational Concepts into IVAS Workflow Platforms.
* Identifying knowledge needs, assisting with best-practice communications, training, continuing education and mentoring as directed by QRM Senior Management.
* Gathering client feedback, identifying process gaps and improvement opportunities, and supporting technology innovation.
* Creating and maintaining all registers/licenses and associated procedures to ensure regulatory, client, QRM Framework and PAG requirements are met.
* Unless otherwise advised, ensuring all master service agreements and valuation and advisory contracts are executed in accordance with QRM Framework and PAG requirements.
* Supporting business development initiatives by participating in proposal responses and new business initiatives, and preparing marketing material/pitches, with a particular focus on communicating the benefits of QRM.
* Improving CBRE’s position during contractual negotiations by actively participating in strategy planning and client meetings, with a particular focus on capping of liability.

**What You'll Need:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual will need to perform each crucial duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

* Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 10 years of commercial appraisal experience, preferably involved with Institutional Funds clients. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. Must have General State Certification/License in at least one state and MAI designation.
* Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.
* Advanced knowledge of the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice (USPAP) preferred.
* Ability to lead the exchange of complicated and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.
* Leadership skills to set, manage, and achieve targets with a direct impact on multiple department results within a function.
* In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Expert organizational skills and an advanced inquisitive approach.

**Why CBRE**

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

**Our Values in Hiring**

At CBRE, we are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels they belong. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and we welcome all applications.

**Applicant AI Use Disclosure**

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

**Disclaimers**

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

**About CBRE Group, Inc.**

CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE:CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm (based on 2024 revenue). The company has more than 140,000 employees (including Turner & Townsend employees) serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage serving, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at www.cbre.com.

CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the IVAS Quality & Risk Management Senior Director position is $165,000.00 annually and the maximum salary for the IVAS Quality & Risk Management Senior Director position is $215,000.00 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. This role will provide the following benefits: 401(K), Dental insurance, Health insurance, Life insurance, and Vision insurance. Successful candidates will also be eligible for a discretionary bonus based on CBRE’s applicable benefit program.

 
**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE has a long-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law. 
 
**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at +1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and +1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

card.description:
**Quality/Risk Director Career Opportunity**

**Highly regarded and valued for your Quality/Risk Director expertise** 
Are you seeking a career that not only utilizes your skills but also aligns with your personal values, providing a profound sense of belonging and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference in patients' lives? Look no further than Encompass Health, the nation's leader in in-patient rehabilitation care. As a Quality/Risk Director, you will oversee a hospital-wide quality management program, collaborating with various stakeholders to monitor and enhance the quality of patient care services. Join a team that values collaboration, support, and inclusivity, and embark on a rewarding career close to home and close to your heart, complete with access to cutting-edge equipment and technology and a comprehensive benefits package from day one.

**A Glimpse into Our World** 
At Encompass Health, you'll experience the difference the moment you become a part of our team. Being at Encompass Health means aligning with a rapidly growing national inpatient rehabilitation leader. We take pride in the growth opportunities we offer and how our team unites for the greater good of our patients. Our achievements include being named one of the "World's Most Admired Companies" and receiving the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® Award, among other accolades, which is nothing short of amazing.

**Starting Perks and Benefits** 
At Encompass Health, we are committed to creating a supportive, inclusive, and caring environment where you can thrive. From **day one,** you will have access to:

* Affordable medical, dental, and vision plans for both full-time and part-time employees and their families.
* Generous paid time off that accrues over time.
* Opportunities for tuition reimbursement and continuing education.
* Company-matching 401(k) and employee stock purchase plans.
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts.
* A vibrant community of individuals passionate about the work they do!

**Become the Quality/Risk Director you've always aspired to be**

* Ensure compliance with regulatory agencies, accrediting bodies, corporate and hospital policies, and procedures. Develop, implement, and maintain quality assessment and improvement programs.
* Assess compliance with federal, state, and industry regulatory and accreditation standards, facilitating processes to remediate and/or maintain compliance. Provide organizational education related to regulations and standards and coordinate local, state, federal, and accreditation surveys.
* Use a variety of applications (including, but not limited to, PatCom, UDS, ORYX, and Press Ganey) to identify improvement opportunities, generate reports, research issues, identify resources, and access external databases.
* Ensure the update and maintenance of hospital plans, including the Provision of Care/Scope of Services, Leadership, Information Management, Utilization Review, Infection Control, and Patient Safety plans. Oversee risk management activities, including completion of incident reports, notice of potential claims, corrective action planning, and incident reporting to the Corporate Risk Manager.
* Coordinate the review, development, and implementation of hospital policies.
* .Communicate and collaborate with other departments to coordinate care and promptly resolve patient concerns or complaints.
* Celebrate the accomplishments and successes of our dedicated employees along the way.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor's degree in healthcare or a related field is preferred.
* License or Certification as required by state regulations.
* Experience in Quality and/or Risk Management, including primary responsibility for performance improvement activities, regulatory compliance, conflict resolution, leadership, and risk management activities.

#LI-JA1

**The Encompass Health Way**

We proudly set the standard in care by leading with empathy, doing what's right, focusing on the positive, and standing stronger together. Encompass Health is a trusted leader in post-acute care with over 150 nationwide locations and a team of 36,000 exceptional individuals and growing!

At Encompass Health, we celebrate and welcome diversity in our inclusive culture. We provide equal employment opportunities regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, color, creed, age, mental or physical disability, or any other protected classification.

card.title: Director Quality and Education
card.description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the**Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award**, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

At Crème de la Crème, learning comes alive like nowhere else. Our centers are places that never stand still because kids never do. And when you join us, you’ll become part of that magic—making a memorable impact on young learners and their families every day. In our wow-worthy world of learning, your talents will be the catalyst for creating child care experiences you've never imagined. You’ll link arms with other exceptional humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do—and you’ll know that your work matters.

* As the Crème School Director of Education and Quality, you will 
 + Lead and develop teachers to ensure curriculum alignment with best practices, state standards, and the individual needs of children.
 + Facilitate training and implementation of our comprehensive and developmentally appropriate curriculum for early childhood education.
 + Provide transformative leadership in the field of early childhood education, staying informed about current trends, research, and best practices.
 + Develop a culture of continuous learning and professional development while leading the teaching staff.
 + Establish and maintain high-quality standards for early childhood education program
 + Conduct regular assessments, evaluations, and audits to ensure compliance with Crème standards and licensing requirements
 + Provide guidance and support to teaching staff, promoting a positive and collaborative work environment. In partnership with the Executive Director, host professional development programs to enhance educators' skills and knowledge.
 + Cultivate positive relationships with teachers and parents, involving them in their child's education and development.
 + Collaborate with the community to enhance the educational experience and promote your school within the community.
 + Assist as needed in daily school operations, at times including direct supervision of children
 + Apply data-driven insights to assess program effectiveness, implement strategies to address identified areas of improvement, fostering a culture of continuous quality enhancement.
* Qualifications:
* + Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Education Administration, or a related field. (preferred)
 + Meet state specific credentials / guidelines for the role
 + At least one year leadership experience in early childhood education or a related field
 + Proven understanding of early childhood development, educational best practices, and program administration.
 + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 + Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and multi-task and handle multiple situations optimally.
 + Proven ability to build and sustain positive relationships with diverse staff, families, and community. Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in education.
 + Physically able to use a computer with basic proficiency, lift a minimum of 40pounds, and work indoors or outdoors.
 + Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity.
 + Read, write, understand, and speak English to connect with children and their parents in English.

**Our benefits meet you where you are.** We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life: 

* Know your whole family is supported with **discounted child care** benefits.

* Breathe easy with **medical, dental, and vision** benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
* Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with **employee assistance programs.**
* Feel great and thrive with access to **health and wellness programs, paid time off** and **discounts** for work necessities, such as cell phones.
* … and much more.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

*KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.*

=========================================

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that enable exceptional member and provider experiences. 
The Director, Quality Engineering – Test Data Management (EQE) is a senior technology leader responsible for defining, advancing, and operating Humana's enterprise Test Data Management (TDM) function within Enterprise Quality Engineering. Reporting to the VP, Quality Engineering, this role leads the strategy, operating model, and execution of secure, scalable, compliant, and automation-enabled test data capabilities that support software delivery across Humana's business and technology organizations. 
This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing organization responsible for core TDM services, including test data provisioning, synthetic data generation, masking, de-identification, data lifecycle management, and environment data coordination. The Director will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Risk, and Data teams to ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to delivery, compliance, and release readiness needs. 
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in test data management, data engineering, governance, privacy, and automation in a complex enterprise environment. This role will drive modernization of TDM practices through automation-first and AI-enabled capabilities, while establishing standards, controls, and reusable services that improve engineering throughput, reduce delivery friction, and strengthen compliance and data protection across non-production environments.

**Leadership, Strategy & Operating Model**

* Lead the enterprise Test Data Management function within EQE, including strategic direction, operating model execution, and organizational development.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of managers, engineers, and test data specialists across multiple groups supporting segment and enterprise needs.
* Oversee a distributed organization of **50+ associates** and create clear priorities, role clarity, and performance expectations.
* Partner with Quality Engineering, Engineering, Product, Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, Security, and Data teams to align TDM services with business and delivery priorities.
* Drive a scalable support model for segment TDM services across multiple portfolios and delivery teams.
* Promote a culture of quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of secure test data practices.

**Test Data Engineering & Management**

 

* Lead enterprise engineering and management of secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Oversee delivery of core TDM capabilities, including:Test data provisioningSynthetic data generationData masking and obfuscationData de-identificationData quality enablementTest data automationData lifecycle managementEnvironment data coordination
* Ensure test data is available, fit for purpose, and aligned to quality engineering, release, and environment needs.
* Advance data engineering practices that improve the reliability, reusability, and speed of test data provisioning across delivery pipelines.
* Support complex testing needs across functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and non-production validation use cases.

**AI-Enabled & Automation-First TDM**

 

* Drive **AI-enabled** and automation-first TDM strategies to improve speed, intelligence, scalability, and coverage of test data operations.
* Expand the use of AI and advanced automation for synthetic data generation, sensitive data detection, masking rule optimization, provisioning efficiency, and data quality insights.
* Integrate TDM automation into CI/CD and engineering workflows where applicable to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
* Partner with enterprise engineering and platform teams to modernize TDM tooling, workflows, and reusable patterns.
* Establish metrics to evaluate automation effectiveness, data readiness, cycle time reduction, and business value realization.

**Governance, Standards, Compliance & Privacy**

 

* Define and enforce enterprise TDM standards, governance, and operating policies.
* Ensure compliance with privacy, security, and regulatory requirements related to test data usage, storage, movement, masking, and de-identification.
* Oversee implementation of compliance and privacy controls for non-production data usage.
* Establish standards for secure handling of production-like data in test environments.
* Partner with security, risk, privacy, and compliance stakeholders to maintain appropriate controls and audit readiness.
* Promote consistent governance for test data access, retention, refresh, lineage, and lifecycle management.

* Enable delivery teams through timely, compliant, and high-quality test data services that improve engineering throughput and release readiness.

* Coordinate across environments and shared services to reduce delays related to data setup, refresh, and availability.
* Influence engineering and quality practices that improve testability, environment readiness, and quality outcomes.
* Collaborate with enterprise enablement and platform teams to standardize capabilities and reduce duplication.

* Define and monitor KPIs related to test data availability, provisioning speed, automation adoption, compliance adherence, data quality, and operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across TDM services.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce manual work, increase data reliability, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Provide clear reporting and operational transparency to senior leadership and stakeholders.

=====================================

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any technology related degree or equivalent experience.
* **10+ years** of experience in quality engineering, test data management, data engineering, software engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* **5+ years** of leadership experience managing enterprise-scale technology teams, including managers and geographically distributed associates.
* Experience leading or scaling **test data management**, data engineering, or quality engineering functions in a large enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated success building and operating secure, scalable, and compliant test data solutions.
* Experience with key TDM capabilities such as data provisioning, masking, obfuscation, de-identification, synthetic data generation, and lifecycle management.
* Strong understanding of privacy, security, and compliance considerations for test data in regulated environments.
* Experience driving automation and process modernization across engineering or quality workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence across engineering, quality, data, and business organizations.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments and supporting modern software delivery practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Experience in healthcare, payer/insurance, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience supporting enterprise quality engineering or platform enablement organizations.
* Familiarity with test data management platforms, masking tools, synthetic data solutions, and data quality tooling.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise engineering platforms.
* Experience applying AI or machine learning capabilities to test data, quality engineering, or operational optimization.
* Familiarity with data governance, data retention, and environment management practices in large-scale enterprises.

**Success in this Role**

In this role, success will be measured by:

* Improved speed, reliability, and scalability of enterprise test data provisioning and support.
* Increased adoption of secure, compliant, and reusable TDM solutions across segments and teams.
* Reduced delivery delays caused by test data availability, quality, or environment coordination issues.
* Strong compliance with privacy, security, masking, and de-identification requirements.

card.description:
**Job Description Summary:**

The Ingredient Quality Department protects ingredient quality and integrity across our beverage portfolio. We are seeking a **Senior Manager, Ingredient Quality & Analytical Science** with advanced analytical chemistry expertise and the judgment and influence to resolve complex ingredient-quality challenges.

This hands-on subject matter expert and individual contributor brings expertise in GC- and LC-HRMS, method development and validation, chemical profiling, unknown identification, contaminant analysis, authenticity testing, and raw material characterization. They apply data analytics to turn complex analytical results into actionable insights that support product quality and business decisions.

You will define analytical strategies, lead investigations and cross-functional projects, interpret complex data, strengthen laboratory capability, and translate evidence into actionable recommendations. Success requires scientific rigor, concise communication, and influence without formal supervisory authority.

This on-site Atlanta, Georgia role follows standard business hours, Monday through Friday, with occasional early-morning, evening, or weekend work as business needs require.

 

**What You’ll Do**

After onboarding and required training, you will work independently at trainer-level proficiency to:

* Serve as a senior SME in HRMS, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, LC-QTOF, chromatographic separations, mass spectral interpretation, and related technologies.
* Direct complex investigations of atypical or out-of-specification results, contamination, authenticity concerns, supplier variability, degradation, and unexplained chemical or sensory differences.
* Mentor and coach scientists and laboratory colleagues across the laboratory network.

**What We Can Do for You**

* **Technical Excellence:** Expand your expertise with state-of-the-art technology, an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory, mature quality systems, and industry leaders in flavor quality-control methodology at a globally recognized organization.
* **Industry Expertise:** Deepen your ingredient-quality expertise, including flavors and their food and beverage applications.
* **Career Development:** Partner with manufacturing, flavor R&D, and global functions to build your career within a global beverage company.
* **Benefits:** Competitive benefits begin on your first day of employment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Analytical Science and Methods**
----------------------------------

* Design and execute targeted and non-targeted studies of food, flavor, and beverage ingredients to characterize volatile and non-volatile components, chemical fingerprints, quality, variability, impurities, degradation products, contaminants, and potential adulterants; identify and quantify known and unknown compounds.

* Confirm compound identities using accurate mass, isotope patterns, fragmentation behavior, MS/MS spectra, reference standards, and spectral libraries; optimize sample preparation and troubleshoot methods, instruments, and matrix effects.

* Develop, optimize, validate, verify, transfer, and implement fit-for-purpose LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, HRMS, and complementary methods; evaluate performance and author protocols, reports, SOPs, and technical documentation.

**Ingredient Quality and Laboratory Excellence**
------------------------------------------------

* Lead ingredient assessments and investigations that support supplier qualification, specification setting, release decisions, root-cause analysis, risk mitigation, alternative sourcing, and supply continuity.

* Integrate analytical findings with historical profiles, supplier and manufacturing data, regulatory requirements, and scientific literature to deliver defensible recommendations.

* Champion GLP, ISO/IEC 17025, the Quality Management System, data integrity, audit readiness, CAPA, laboratory safety, and confidentiality, ensuring all records and reports are scientifically sound.

* Lead laboratory capability development, technology evaluation, and instrument lifecycle management; improve throughput, reproducibility, data quality, and efficiency through automation, digital workflows, and continuous improvement.

**Digital, Leadership and Communication**
-----------------------------------------

* Use data analytics, visualization, and digital tools to communicate complex results, uncertainty, quality risk, and data gaps as clear scientific conclusions and business recommendations.

* Lead cross-functional projects and partner with manufacturing, R&D, procurement, regulatory, and supplier teams to resolve ingredient-quality issues.

* Present findings, risks, and recommendations concisely to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.

undefined 

 

**What We’re Looking For**

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s in chemistry, or biochemistry, or a related field with 10+ years of industry experience, or a master’s with 5+ years. Extensive advanced analytical lab experience required; master’s or Ph.D. preferred.

* Extensive hands-on experience operating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and interpreting data from chromatography and mass spectrometry platforms (LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, and/or HRMS).

* Experience with complex matrices, sample preparation, chemical characterization, quantitative and trace analysis, unknown investigations, and the full analytical method lifecycle.

* Proven ability to lead complex scientific projects and influence technical disciplines without direct authority.

* Food, beverage, flavor, ingredient, natural product, consumer product, pharmaceutical, or similar industry experience is preferred; ISO/IEC 17025, GLP, or comparable quality-system experience is an advantage.

**Technical and Digital Capabilities**
--------------------------------------

* Experience with targeted and non-targeted analysis, chemical fingerprinting, trace quantitation, contaminants, authenticity, unknown identification, ingredient chemistry, degradation products, and impurities.

* Strong grasp of method development and validation, reference standards, quality control, measurement performance, SOPs, technical documentation, and instrument troubleshooting.

**Leadership Attributes**
-------------------------

* Scientific rigor, curiosity, sound judgment, accountability, and a commitment to reliable results.

* Strategic, evidence-based problem solving that links analytical findings to ingredient risk, supplier capability, laboratory strategy, and business needs.

* Ability to set priorities, lead through influence, collaborate across boundaries, coach others, and communicate clear, actionable recommendations.

* Commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, safety, scientific integrity, data quality, confidentiality, and quality standards.

* undefined

**Business Understanding and Systems Knowledge**

* Apply systems thinking to balance scientific rigor, ingredient risk, operational needs, and supply continuity.
* Build scientific and business cases for capability investments and new ways of working.
* Bring relevant external scientific and industry developments into the organization while maintaining confidentiality and a customer-focused mindset.

**Working Conditions**

* Primarily on-site in Atlanta, Georgia, across laboratory, manufacturing-site, and office environments.
* Operate and oversee advanced analytical instruments and safely handle chemicals and ingredient samples.
* Occasional work outside standard hours may be required.

**Travel Requirements**

Limited travel may be required to support suppliers, partner laboratories, technical partners, scientific collaborations, or capability development.

**Job Description Summary:**

The Ingredient Quality Department protects ingredient quality and integrity across our beverage portfolio. We are seeking a **Senior Manager, Ingredient Quality & Analytical Science** with advanced analytical chemistry expertise and the judgment and influence to resolve complex ingredient-quality challenges.

This hands-on subject matter expert and individual contributor brings expertise in GC- and LC-HRMS, method development and validation, chemical profiling, unknown identification, contaminant analysis, authenticity testing, and raw material characterization. They apply data analytics to turn complex analytical results into actionable insights that support product quality and business decisions.

You will define analytical strategies, lead investigations and cross-functional projects, interpret complex data, strengthen laboratory capability, and translate evidence into actionable recommendations. Success requires scientific rigor, concise communication, and influence without formal supervisory authority.

This on-site Atlanta, Georgia role follows standard business hours, Monday through Friday, with occasional early-morning, evening, or weekend work as business needs require.

 

**What You’ll Do**

After onboarding and required training, you will work independently at trainer-level proficiency to:

* Serve as a senior SME in HRMS, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, LC-QTOF, chromatographic separations, mass spectral interpretation, and related technologies.
* Direct complex investigations of atypical or out-of-specification results, contamination, authenticity concerns, supplier variability, degradation, and unexplained chemical or sensory differences.
* Mentor and coach scientists and laboratory colleagues across the laboratory network.

**What We Can Do for You**

* **Technical Excellence:** Expand your expertise with state-of-the-art technology, an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory, mature quality systems, and industry leaders in flavor quality-control methodology at a globally recognized organization.
* **Industry Expertise:** Deepen your ingredient-quality expertise, including flavors and their food and beverage applications.
* **Career Development:** Partner with manufacturing, flavor R&D, and global functions to build your career within a global beverage company.
* **Benefits:** Competitive benefits begin on your first day of employment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Analytical Science and Methods**
----------------------------------

* Design and execute targeted and non-targeted studies of food, flavor, and beverage ingredients to characterize volatile and non-volatile components, chemical fingerprints, quality, variability, impurities, degradation products, contaminants, and potential adulterants; identify and quantify known and unknown compounds.

* Confirm compound identities using accurate mass, isotope patterns, fragmentation behavior, MS/MS spectra, reference standards, and spectral libraries; optimize sample preparation and troubleshoot methods, instruments, and matrix effects.

* Develop, optimize, validate, verify, transfer, and implement fit-for-purpose LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, HRMS, and complementary methods; evaluate performance and author protocols, reports, SOPs, and technical documentation.

**Ingredient Quality and Laboratory Excellence**
------------------------------------------------

* Lead ingredient assessments and investigations that support supplier qualification, specification setting, release decisions, root-cause analysis, risk mitigation, alternative sourcing, and supply continuity.

* Integrate analytical findings with historical profiles, supplier and manufacturing data, regulatory requirements, and scientific literature to deliver defensible recommendations.

* Champion GLP, ISO/IEC 17025, the Quality Management System, data integrity, audit readiness, CAPA, laboratory safety, and confidentiality, ensuring all records and reports are scientifically sound.

* Lead laboratory capability development, technology evaluation, and instrument lifecycle management; improve throughput, reproducibility, data quality, and efficiency through automation, digital workflows, and continuous improvement.

**Digital, Leadership and Communication**
-----------------------------------------

* Use data analytics, visualization, and digital tools to communicate complex results, uncertainty, quality risk, and data gaps as clear scientific conclusions and business recommendations.

* Lead cross-functional projects and partner with manufacturing, R&D, procurement, regulatory, and supplier teams to resolve ingredient-quality issues.

* Present findings, risks, and recommendations concisely to stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s in chemistry, or biochemistry, or a related field with 10+ years of industry experience, or a master’s with 5+ years. Extensive advanced analytical lab experience required; master’s or Ph.D. preferred.

* Extensive hands-on experience operating, maintaining, troubleshooting, and interpreting data from chromatography and mass spectrometry platforms (LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, and/or HRMS).

* Experience with complex matrices, sample preparation, chemical characterization, quantitative and trace analysis, unknown investigations, and the full analytical method lifecycle.

* Proven ability to lead complex scientific projects and influence technical disciplines without direct authority.

* Food, beverage, flavor, ingredient, natural product, consumer product, pharmaceutical, or similar industry experience is preferred; ISO/IEC 17025, GLP, or comparable quality-system experience is an advantage.

**Technical and Digital Capabilities**
--------------------------------------

* Experience with targeted and non-targeted analysis, chemical fingerprinting, trace quantitation, contaminants, authenticity, unknown identification, ingredient chemistry, degradation products, and impurities.

* Strong grasp of method development and validation, reference standards, quality control, measurement performance, SOPs, technical documentation, and instrument troubleshooting.

**Leadership Attributes**
-------------------------

* Scientific rigor, curiosity, sound judgment, accountability, and a commitment to reliable results.

* Strategic, evidence-based problem solving that links analytical findings to ingredient risk, supplier capability, laboratory strategy, and business needs.

* Ability to set priorities, lead through influence, collaborate across boundaries, coach others, and communicate clear, actionable recommendations.

* Commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, safety, scientific integrity, data quality, confidentiality, and quality standards.

* undefined

**Business Understanding and Systems Knowledge**

* Apply systems thinking to balance scientific rigor, ingredient risk, operational needs, and supply continuity.
* Build scientific and business cases for capability investments and new ways of working.
* Bring relevant external scientific and industry developments into the organization while maintaining confidentiality and a customer-focused mindset.

**Working Conditions**

* Primarily on-site in Atlanta, Georgia, across laboratory, manufacturing-site, and office environments.
* Operate and oversee advanced analytical instruments and safely handle chemicals and ingredient samples.
* Occasional work outside standard hours may be required.

**Travel Requirements**

Limited travel may be required to support suppliers, partner laboratories, technical partners, scientific collaborations, or capability development.

The Coca-Cola Company will not offer sponsorship for employment status (including, but not limited to, H1-B visa status and other employment-based nonimmigrant visas) for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis and must not require The Coca-Cola Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.
